faqLeft.q: What engine does the Jaguar F-Pace SVR use?
faqLeft.a: The F-Pace SVR uses the AJ133 5.0-litre supercharged V8, badged as P550 - the same engine family found in the Range Rover Sport SVR and Velar SVAutobiography.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Jaguar F-Pace SVR engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my F-Pace SVR?
faqLeft.a: All F-Pace SVR models use the AJ133 5.0-litre supercharged V8. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ133 F-Pace SVR engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components and bearings as standard on every AJ133 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used F-Pace SVR engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my F-Pace SVR if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an F-Pace SVR engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most F-Pace SVR owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
